name: classroom-hub
description: Classroom Hub - Full-stack classroom management platform

scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('server/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example', 'server/.env'); if (!fs.existsSync('web/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('web/.env.example', 'web/.env'); console.log('Created server/.env and web/.env from templates.');"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
